gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants must have a histologically-confirmed recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumor including, but not limited to, infant-type hemispheric glioma, gliosarcoma, intracranial sarcoma and WHO Grade II ependymoma.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Gliosarcoma is named only as one example of an open-ended list of paediatric-oriented malignant brain tumours (conditions list only paediatric brain tumour); could be not_glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: The TGFβi NK cell product will be manufactured in the Cell Therapy Laboratory at Nationwide Children's Hospital and given via infusion.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have a histologically-confirmed recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumor

role_evidence.quote: The TGFβi NK cell product will be manufactured in the Cell Therapy Laboratory at Nationwide Children's Hospital and given via infusion.
